strengths: The observe() pools are now genuinely deep across all five clusters — 5-6 distinct variants each, with real tonal variety within pools rather than mere paraphrase. 'Thinking has become her favourite weather' and 'Want has become a quiet, constant houseguest' are lines worth keeping.

The late-birth child pool (3 lines) and the dynasty-flag guard on 'red and furious' (S._usedFurious, confirmed used only once across 15 lives in transcripts) is exactly the right surgical fix — the line lands with appropriate weight at Bram Vasquez and never recurs.

Motto variety across five dynasties is genuine and distinct: no convergence at all in this sample. The fix separating lived-experience reputation scoring from inherited-heirloom carry-over has worked structurally.

The callback system is the literary centrepiece and it earns its billing. The 49-year arc of Adaline Vasquez looking away at age 9 and making amends at 58 is moving on the page. The book-heirloom chain through the Salvedi line is sound literary architecture — decisions made in one life create legible texture in subsequent ones.

The affair card now has three rotated variants with genuinely different registers ('A door opens that she did not knock on' / 'Someone looks at her the way the spouse stopped looking' / 'It would be so easy, and so quiet'), and the close-the-door branch has three cold-register variants. Competent.

Epitaph anti-repetition logic (cluster tracking, recent-two blocking, per-generation rotation) visibly works across the transcripts — fifteen lives, fifteen distinct epitaphs, no cluster appears more than twice in any dynasty.
blockers: The marriage logline pool has only 3 variants ('Nobody made a speech; the years that followed were the speech.' / 'They made it formal on an ordinary day, and meant every word of it.' / 'The day was small and the meaning was not.') and marriage is near-universal across long sessions. In Dynasty 5 alone, three different marriages resolve to these same three lines across four generations. This is the single most-repeated prose in any extended play and it is the game's most emotionally loaded beat — the thinness here undermines what the surrounding prose earns.

The love-opening card (y_love1) has 5 variants but they are structurally identical in angle: someone keeps appearing, the character has noticed, the noticing runs both ways. The rotation changes the surface prose without changing the register or the shape of how love begins. A player who plays three dynasties experiences all five within a few lives. A variant that begins from the character's side (noticing an absence, or love recognised in retrospect) would give the pool genuine variety, not just paraphrase.

improvements.what: Add 3-4 marriage logline variants to the a_marry card's do() block, using rotI or rotN. Include at least one late-marriage line (since late-love cards are common) and one that acknowledges the weight of time rather than the smallness of ceremony.
improvements.why: Marriage is the most universally triggered moment in long sessions, and three variants repeat visibly within a single 5-generation dynasty. This is the lowest-hanging prose fix with the highest experiential return.

improvements.what: Add 2 love-opening variants to y_love1 that approach from a different angle — e.g., one where the character notices love through its absence ('Someone has gone quiet for three days, and the quiet has a shape') or one where the recognition is internal and unnamed before it is social.
improvements.why: The current 5 variants all describe love from the outside (someone keeps appearing). Varying the angle gives the pool genuine depth rather than surface rotation.

improvements.what: The affair card text uses gen rotation (rotN(p.gen,3)) which means the same player sees the same variant each dynasty. Switch to a player-responsive condition — e.g., vary by whether the spouse's bond is below a threshold, or whether the player has already had a child — so the text reads as causally connected to this life's specific situation.
improvements.why: The affair is the game's highest-stakes prose moment. Mechanical rotation by generation misses the opportunity for the text to feel discovered rather than served.

improvements.what: Expand the y_love1 'pretend not to notice' refusal logline beyond the single current line ('Let someone slip away by saying nothing. Wondered, later, often.') to 2-3 variants. The refusal path is chosen in roughly half of sessions and currently always reads identically.
improvements.why: The roads-not-taken appear in the transcript alongside every choice. A single refusal line is visible in five transcripts within the same file.

verdict: The prose foundation is genuinely literary — patient, precise, with a callback architecture that gives a dynasty the shape of a real story — but the marriage beat, which every long session triggers multiple times, is served by only three variants and the repetition undercuts what the surrounding writing earns.
